title: 拉电流与灌电流：低电平点亮的 LED
summary: Blue Pill 上接两颗 LED：一颗从引脚流出电流（输出高亮），一颗把电流流进引脚（输出低亮）。两颗灯的逻辑正好相反。
concepts: 弱驱动引脚 PC13–PC15 weak pins
description: LED1：GPIO_OUT1 → 220 Ω → LED1 → GND（拉电流）。LED2：3V3 → 220 Ω → LED2 → GPIO_OUT2（灌电流）。推挽输出里有一个接 3V3 的上开关和一个接 GND 的下开关，模型里各约 40 Ω。参考答案用 PB11 和 PB10，别的输出脚也算对。

en.startNote: **Half-built**: the Blue Pill is seated, GND and 3V3 run to the top rails, PB11 is set to output high and PB10 to output low. **Why**: powering the board was lesson 15; this lab is about which way round the LED goes. **Your job**: build two branches: PB11 → 220Ω → LED1 → GND (sourcing); 3V3 → 220Ω → LED2 → PB10 (sinking).
en.title: Sourcing and sinking: an LED lit by LOW
en.summary: Two LEDs on a Blue Pill: one takes current out of a pin (lit by HIGH), the other sends current into a pin (lit by LOW). Their logic is exactly opposite.
en.description: LED1: GPIO_OUT1 → 220 Ω → LED1 → GND (sourcing). LED2: 3V3 → 220 Ω → LED2 → GPIO_OUT2 (sinking). A push-pull output has a switch to 3V3 and a switch to GND, about 40 Ω each in the model. The reference uses PB11 and PB10; other output pins count too.
compare: - OUT1 HIGH, OUT2 LOW: **both LEDs on**. I1 = I2 = (3.3 − 1.8) / (40 + 220 + 12) ≈ **5.5 mA**; OUT1's pin current is +5.5 mA (out), OUT2's −5.5 mA (in).
- OUT2's LOW ≈ 40 Ω × 5.5 mA ≈ **0.22 V**: a LOW is not exactly 0 V.
- OUT1 LOW, OUT2 HIGH: **both off**. Both ends of LED2 are at 3.3 V, so there is no voltage across it.
- OUT2 as an input: LED2 off, the pin pulled to about 3.3 − 1.8 ≈ 1.5 V.

In real chips the low side (N-channel) is usually stronger than the high side, so sinking drops less. Old TTL and 8051 parts could only sink, which is why so many classic circuits light their LEDs with LOW.

measurements.ask: OUT1 HIGH, OUT2 LOW: the current in LED1 (sourcing)
measurements.explain: High side on: (3.3 − 1.8) / (40 + 220 + 12) ≈ 5.5 mA, flowing out of the pin.

measurements.ask: Same state: the current in LED2 (sinking)
measurements.explain: Low side on: (3.3 − 1.8) / (220 + 12 + 40) ≈ 5.5 mA, flowing into the pin.

measurements.ask: Same state: multimeter on the OUT2 pin to GND (output LOW, but sinking current)
measurements.explain: ≈ 40 Ω × 5.5 mA ≈ 0.22 V: a LOW is not exactly 0 V either.

measurements.ask: From your two readings, the low-side (N-channel) on-resistance = V_OL / I2
measurements.explain: ≈ 40 Ω (the model uses the same for both sides). In a real chip the N-channel side is usually stronger, so sinking drops less; old TTL / 8051 parts could only sink.

measurements.ask: OUT2 set as an input (high-Z): the OUT2 pin to GND
measurements.explain: No current, LED2 is off; 3V3 pulls the pin through R2 and the LED to 3.3 − 1.8 ≈ 1.5 V, between VIL and VIH.

hints: LED1 is the familiar way: pin → resistor → LED → GND.
LED2 is upside down: 3V3 → resistor → LED long lead; the LED's short lead goes to the second pin.
Wire a board 3V3 pin to the top + rail first so R2 can reach it.
tests: OUT1 HIGH, OUT2 LOW: both on; OUT1 sources, OUT2 sinks
OUT1 LOW, OUT2 HIGH: both off
OUT2 as input: LED2 off; PC13 LOW: the onboard LED sinks less than 3 mA

cards.title: Two LEDs, opposite logic
text: Wire two red LEDs to a **Blue Pill**, each with **`220 Ω`**:
- **LED1**: pin → resistor → LED → GND, the familiar way.
- **LED2** upside down: **3V3** → resistor → LED long lead; the LED's short lead goes to a **second pin**.
Under Properties set **both pins to OUT HIGH**, then **both to OUT LOW**. When is each LED lit?

cards.title: Two switches inside a pin
text: - An output pin holds two switches: one to **3V3** (the high side) and one to **GND** (the low side), about 40 Ω each in the model. Output high closes the high side; output low closes the low side.
- **Output high**: current comes from 3V3 through the high side, **out of** the pin, through LED1 back to GND. This is **sourcing**:
![](fig:source)
- **Output low**: current comes from 3V3 through LED2, **into** the pin, and through the low side to GND. This is **sinking**:
![](fig:sink)
- Both paths hold the same resistances, so the sum is the same:
- For example with 470 Ω: $I = \frac{3.3 - 1.8}{470 + 12 + 40} ≈ 0.0029$ A, about 2.9 mA.

cards.title: Wire it, measure both ways
text: - First wire the board's **3V3** pin to the top + rail and a **GND** pin to the − rail, so R2 can reach them.
- Use two ordinary output pins (the reference uses PB11 and PB10). **Avoid PC13–PC15**: they only give 3 mA.
- Press **Check my circuit**; the check switches both pins by itself. Once it passes, read both LED currents and the pin voltage, and watch the current's direction.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Output high → current flows out of the pin (sourcing); output low → current flows in (sinking).** An LED on the 3V3 side is "lit by LOW".
- The Blue Pill's onboard PC13 LED is wired to sink, which is why the program writes LOW to light it. Active-low signals are common on reset pins and chip-select lines too.
- With the pin set as an input LED2 is off, but the pin voltage sits between low and high. Real chips leak a little, so the LED sometimes glows faintly.

- A real-circuit catch: to hang the LED on 5 V instead, the pin must be a **5 V-tolerant FT pin** set to open-drain (5.6). With a push-pull output, 5 V would flow through the protection diode into 3V3.

tests.name: OUT1 高、OUT2 低：两个 LED 都亮；OUT1 拉电流，OUT2 灌电流
OUT1 低、OUT2 高：两个 LED 都灭
OUT2 设为输入：LED2 灭；PC13 输出低：板载 LED 的灌电流在 3 mA 以内

compare: - OUT2 的低电平 ≈ 40 Ω × 5.5 mA ≈ **0.22 V**：低电平也不是正好 0 V。
- OUT1 低、OUT2 高：两颗灯**都灭**。LED2 两端都是 3.3 V，没有电压差。
- OUT2 设成输入：LED2 灭，引脚被拉到约 3.3 − 1.8 ≈ 1.5 V。
真实芯片里下开关（N 管）一般比上开关更强，灌电流时压降更小。老的 TTL / 51 单片机只能灌、不能拉，所以很多经典电路里的 LED 都是低电平点亮。

measurements.explain: 没有电流，LED2 灭；引脚被 3V3 经 R2 和 LED 拉到 3.3 − 1.8 ≈ 1.5 V，介于 VIL 和 VIH 之间。

LED2 是倒过来的：3V3 → 电阻 → LED 长脚；LED 短脚接第二个引脚。
先把开发板的 3V3 脚接到上方 + 轨，R2 才好接。
startNote: **半成品**：Blue Pill 已经插好，GND 和 3V3 已经引到上方电源轨，PB11 设成输出高、PB10 设成输出低。**为什么**：开发板的供电第 15 课练过；这个实验的重点是 LED 朝哪个方向接。**你要做**：搭两条支路：PB11 → 220Ω → LED1 → GND（拉电流）；3V3 → 220Ω → LED2 → PB10（灌电流）。

cards.title: 两颗灯，逻辑相反
text: 在 **Blue Pill** 上接两颗红色 LED，都配 **`220 Ω`**：
- **LED1**：引脚 → 电阻 → LED → GND，熟悉的接法。
- **LED2** 倒过来：**3V3** → 电阻 → LED 长脚；LED 短脚接**第二个引脚**。
在「属性」里把两个引脚**都设成「输出 高」**，再**都设成「输出 低」**。每颗灯什么时候亮？

cards.title: 引脚里有两个开关
text: - 输出引脚里有两个开关：一个通 **3V3**（上开关），一个通 **GND**（下开关），模型里各约 40 Ω。输出高时上开关合上，输出低时下开关合上。
- **输出高**：电流从 3V3 经上开关**流出**引脚，穿过 LED1 回到 GND。这叫**拉电流**：
![](fig:source)
- **输出低**：电流从 3V3 经 LED2 **流进**引脚，再经下开关到 GND。这叫**灌电流**：
![](fig:sink)
- 两条路的电阻一样，所以算法也一样：

cards.title: 接好，测两个方向
text: - 先把开发板的 **3V3** 脚接到上方 + 轨，**GND** 脚接到 − 轨，R2 才好接。
- 用两个普通输出脚（参考答案用 PB11、PB10）。**别用 PC13–PC15**：它们只能给 3 mA。
- 点**「检查我的电路」**，检查会自动切换两个引脚。通过后读两颗灯的电流和引脚电压，注意电流的方向。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **输出高 → 电流流出引脚（拉电流）；输出低 → 电流流进引脚（灌电流）。** 灯接在 3V3 一侧，就是“低电平点亮”。
- Blue Pill 板载的 PC13 灯就是灌电流接法，所以程序写 LOW 它才亮。低电平有效在复位脚、片选线里也很常见。
- 引脚设成输入时 LED2 不亮，可引脚电压停在高低之间。真实芯片有微小漏电，灯有时会微微发光。
- 真实电路里的坑：想让灯接到 5 V 上，引脚必须是**耐 5 V 的 FT 脚**，而且设成开漏输出（5.6 会讲）。推挽输出时 5 V 会经保护二极管灌进 3V3。

caption.text: 拉电流：上开关（40 Ω）合上，电流 I1 从 3V3 流出引脚，经 R1、LED1 到 GND。

i18n.en: Sourcing: the high side (40 Ω) is on; I1 leaves the pin from 3V3 and runs through R1 and LED1 to GND.

caption.text: 灌电流：下开关（40 Ω）合上，电流 I2 从 3V3 经 R2、LED2 流进引脚，再到 GND。

i18n.en: Sinking: the low side (40 Ω) is on; I2 runs from 3V3 through R2 and LED2 into the pin, then to GND.
